exposure: Number of prior cesarean deliveries (1 vs 2)
Seeking trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
outcome: Number of providers contacted before finding one offering TOLAC
Difficulty finding a provider offering TOLAC
Success in attempting TOLAC at the reference hospital
cohort: 128 women who had previously contacted a public tertiary care hospital in Houston, TX, regarding trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) and were recruited through social media.
finding: Women seeking TOLAC often face difficulty finding providers who offer the service, with Black and Hispanic women and those with multiple prior cesarean deliveries potentially encountering greater challenges.
